name: Put-Call Parity Mispricing Trade
summary: A scanner-plus-executor pattern: detect violations of C - P = S - PV(K) - PV(dividends) and monetise them by trading the cheap side against the rich side — which resolves to a conversion when the synthetic is rich and a reversal when it is cheap.

legs.strike_rule: Strike K with the largest absolute parity residual; buy the call when the synthetic long is cheap
n/a — 100 shares, the hedge that locks the residual (direction flips for the conversion case: long stock, short call, long put)

max_profit: The parity residual: |(C - P) - (S - PV(K) - PV(div))| x 100, minus all costs. On liquid US names in 2026 this is typically under $0.02 per share.
max_loss: The residual if the sign or the discounting is computed wrong, plus early assignment on whichever option leg is short, plus borrow costs on the reversal side.

greeks.theta: 0.00 net; the residual IS the carry term

breakevens: None — the payoff is locked at entry.
when_to_use: Educational and diagnostic. The scan is genuinely useful as a data-quality check: a large apparent parity violation on a liquid name almost always means stale quotes, a pending contract adjustment, a hard borrow, or an upcoming special dividend — not free money. Use it as an alert, not as a trade signal.
typical_dte: Any; residuals are largest in long-dated and illiquid strikes, which is exactly where they are least tradable
entry_rules: EXECUTION IS BLOCKED AT LEVEL 3 for the reversal half (naked short put against short stock), and economically blocked for the conversion half (edge smaller than costs). Classify as scan-only.
Scanner formula: residual = (call_mid - put_mid) - (spot_mid - strike/(1 + r x T/365) - PV(declared_dividends_before_expiry)). Flag when |residual| > $0.10 per share.

Every flagged residual must be triaged before any trade is contemplated: (1) are both option quotes fresh within 5 seconds, (2) is the underlying halted, (3) is there an OCC contract adjustment memo, (4) is the borrow rate above 1%, (5) is there an undeclared or special dividend. If any check fails, the residual is explained and not tradable.
Execution gate if all checks pass: residual x 100 - fees - 0.5 x (sum of leg bid-ask widths x 100) > $25 per unit. This will essentially never clear on a liquid name.
Never treat a wide bid-ask midpoint as a price. Compute the residual twice: once at mid and once at executable prices (buy the ask, sell the bid). Only the executable version counts.
management_rules: As a scanner: log every flagged residual with its triage outcome, and use persistent unexplained residuals as a signal that market data is broken, not that an opportunity exists.
If a position is ever established, manage it per the conversion or reversal entry as applicable, including the extrinsic-value assignment watch.
Never scale up on a residual that persists — persistence means it is not a mispricing.
exit_rules: If a conversion or reversal was established, follow that slug's exit rules exactly: unwind all legs by 15:30 ET on expiration day, short option leg first.
Unwind immediately if the residual that justified entry disappears and the position can be closed at or above entry value.
Unwind if either option leg's extrinsic value drops below $0.10.
assignment_risk: Whichever leg is short. In the conversion case, the short call (dividend-driven early exercise). In the reversal case, the short put (interest-driven early exercise). Both deliver 100 shares in an American, share-settled market. The parity relation itself holds only for European options; for American options the relation is an INEQUALITY, and the 'violation' the scanner sees is often just the early-exercise premium correctly priced in.
buying_power: Depends on which side triggers; budget the conversion or reversal requirement, $5,000-$10,000 per unit on a $100 underlying.
liquidity_needs: Sub-penny effective spreads across three or four legs simultaneously. Not achievable retail.
common_mistakes: The biggest: applying the European put-call parity EQUATION to American options, where only the inequality holds. Second: using mid prices. Third: omitting the dividend term or the discount factor, which manufactures phantom residuals of exactly the size of the interest.
zero_dte_notes: At 0DTE the carry term is zero, so parity residuals collapse to bid-ask noise and pin risk.
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
